What this proves, and what it does not
The model uses learned token and position embeddings, one causal scaled dot-product attention head, two residual paths, a tanh feedforward layer and a learned output projection. All 816 parameters are updated with backpropagation and Adam. This deliberately tiny variant omits layer normalization and dropout.
Success means memorizing this one training phrase. It does not demonstrate general language understanding, spelling correction, OS control or continual learning. Command suggestions in the VM still use deterministic rules. The kernel's own echo command remains an ordinary print utility.
Three random-seed runs and 18 finite-difference gradient checks pass in Node. Read the measured test results. Training time depends on your device; no “fastest” claim is made. Use Stop at any time. Closing or hiding this tab stops training. Saving weights downloads only this toy model.
Future work: opt-in local task examples, private datasets you can inspect and delete, idle-only training budgets, frozen production weights, held-out task and safety tests, explicit model promotion and rollback. None of that is running in the background today.
